description.value: Steamworks Mount Pleasant Kitchen & Taphouse is a craft brewery taproom at the gateway to Vancouver's historic Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, pouring 20 Steamworks taps alongside 10 rotating local guest taps. The full kitchen serves reimagined pub classics, bold fusion dishes, and plant-based options including vegan jambalaya. A dog-friendly patio overlooking an urban park adds to its appeal as a neighbourhood gathering spot.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: stands (6 spaces, covered) at 39m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 58m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 68m; rack (3 spaces, covered) at 70m; stands (2 spaces) at 75m; stands (2 spaces) at 80m; stands (2 spaces) at 98m; stands (2 spaces) at 100m. Total: 23 spaces.
